decisions.reason: Flagship electrometer closely aligned with core dosimetry and shown prominently, so very likely to remain.
CT phantom builds on established imaging QA portfolio and has dedicated product page.
Mammography phantom is distant from core dosimetry and imaging QA, making it likely to be discontinued.
Full-field mammography phantom is also distant and overlaps with D, increasing likelihood of withdrawal.
Medical imaging QA instrument line is a flagship focus and directly aligned with strategic direction.
